title: Along the River During the Qingming Festival
synopsis: Zhang Zeduan's famous handscroll painting “Along the River During the Qingming Festival“ captures the everyday lives of ordinary people in the capital of the Northern Song dynasty.

series.title: The Splendor of the Song Dynasty

fullText.simplified:
汴京遗梦——《清明上河图》

    伦敦、巴黎、纽约，每个国际大都市都有自己独特的魅力。中国也有与之类似的城市，不管是北京，还是上海，都以繁荣的景象吸引着无数游人前来参观体验。不过，此刻我们要说的这个“国际大都市”可能是一个你没有听说过的城市——汴京。
    汴京是一千多年前北宋的首都，当时也叫东京，现在被称为开封。汴京附近有汴河，地理环境十分适宜农业经济发展。为了保证粮食的供应和交通的便利，北宋选择了汴京作为首都。发达的水运系统使汴京很快成为北宋重要的物流和商业中心。
    为了防止地方军队壮大，北宋放开了土地对农民的束缚，让人口可以自由流动。由于人口流失，导致了农业税收的锐减。为了弥补财政收入，北宋鼓励工商业发展，以便收取更多工商税。在政策的引导下，人们纷纷来到汴京经商居住，汴京人口达到了100万以上。汴京不仅成为了北宋的经济和文化中心，还是当时世界上人口最多的城市。人们可以在汴京买到全国各地的商品，街头有杂耍表演，听曲的茶楼、巷口小吃摊、豪华大酒楼应有尽有，宣德门外和朱雀门北边的夜市灯火辉煌，颇有现代都市的气息。
    遗憾的是，我们无法穿越时空，去亲眼目睹这些繁华景象。幸运的是，当时有位画家用他出色的画笔，为我们描绘出了这幅神奇的画卷。
    这位画家叫张择端。当时的皇帝宋徽宗热爱艺术，开设了宫廷画院，招募了很多优秀的画家，来到汴京游学的张择端应招成为了一名宫廷画家。为了展现汴京的繁华，也为了让皇帝看到真实的百姓生活，张择端用写实的手法将清明节的汴京画了下来，这就是《清明上河图》。我们可以通过这幅画，一睹汴京这座千年前的国际名城的风采。
    《清明上河图》宽24.8厘米，长528厘米，是一幅长卷轴绢本作品。在构图上采取了中国传统绘画的散点透视法，因此能够将整个城市完整地收进一幅画里。整幅画包含郊外春光、汴河场景、城内街市三个部分，人物多达500余位。如果用现代眼光来看，你甚至能从画中找到“外卖小哥”、“便利店”，甚至像“宠物粮食铺”这样的场景。你能想到的那些现代大都市里的东西，这里基本都有，这让欣赏过程充满了乐趣。
    现在，《清明上河图》原版存放在北京故宫博物院，不定期展出。世界各地博物馆也有不少摹本展出，如果有机会，可以亲眼去看看这个千年前的世界级大都市的风采。
fullText.traditional:
汴京遺夢——《清明上河圖》

    倫敦、巴黎、紐約，每個國際大都市都有自己獨特的魅力。中國也有與之類似的城市，不管是北京，還是上海，都以繁榮的景象吸引著無數遊人前來參觀體驗。不過，此刻我們要說的這個“國際大都市”可能是一個你沒有聽說過的城市——汴京。
    汴京是一千多年前北宋的首都，當時也叫東京，現在被稱為開封。汴京附近有汴河，地理環境十分適宜農業經濟發展。為了保證糧食的供應和交通的便利，北宋選擇了汴京作為首都。發達的水運系統使汴京很快成為北宋重要的物流和商業中心。
    為了防止地方軍隊壯大，北宋放開了土地對農民的束縛，讓人口可以自由流動。由於人口流失，導致了農業稅收的銳減。為了彌補財政收入，北宋鼓勵工商業發展，以便收取更多工商稅。在政策的引導下，人們紛紛來到汴京經商居住，汴京人口達到了100萬以上。汴京不僅成為了北宋的經濟和文化中心，還是當時世界上人口最多的城市。人們可以在汴京買到全國各地的商品，街頭有雜耍表演，聽曲的茶樓、巷口小吃攤、豪華大酒樓應有盡有，宣德門外和朱雀門北邊的夜市燈火輝煌，頗有現代都市的氣息。
    遺憾的是，我們無法穿越時空，去親眼目睹這些繁華景象。幸運的是，當時有位畫家用他出色的畫筆，為我們描繪出了這幅神奇的畫卷。
    這位畫家叫張擇端。當時的皇帝宋徽宗熱愛藝術，開設了宮廷畫院，招募了很多優秀的畫家，來到汴京遊學的張擇端應招成為了一名宮廷畫家。為了展現汴京的繁華，也為了讓皇帝看到真實的百姓生活，張擇端用寫實的手法將清明節的汴京畫了下來，這就是《清明上河圖》。我們可以通過這幅畫，一睹汴京這座千年前的國際名城的風采。
    《清明上河圖》寬24.8釐米，長528釐米，是一幅長卷軸絹本作品。在構圖上採取了中國傳統繪畫的散點透視法，因此能夠將整個城市完整地收進一幅畫裡。整幅畫包含郊外春光、汴河場景、城內街市三個部分，人物多達500餘位。如果用現代眼光來看，你甚至能從畫中找到“外賣小哥”、“便利店”，甚至像“寵物糧食鋪”這樣的場景。你能想到的那些現代大都市裡的東西，這裡基本都有，這讓欣賞過程充滿了樂趣。
    現在，《清明上河圖》原版存放在北京故宮博物院，不定期展出。世界各地博物館也有不少摹本展出，如果有機會，可以親眼去看看這個千年前的世界級大都市的風采。

sentences.english: “Along the River During the Qingming Festival” is 24.8 centimeters wide and 528 centimeters long. It is a handscroll painting on silk.

sentences.simplified: 因此能够将整个城市完整地收进一幅画里。
sentences.traditional: 因此能夠將整個城市完整地收進一幅畫裡。
sentences.pinyin: yīn cǐ néng gòu jiāng zhěng gè chéng shì wán zhěng de shōu jìn yì fú huà lǐ
sentences.english: The composition adopts the scattered perspective method of traditional Chinese painting, ..

sentences.simplified: 整幅画包含郊外春光、汴河场景、城内街市三个部分，
sentences.traditional: 整幅畫包含郊外春光、汴河場景、城內街市三個部分，
sentences.pinyin: zhěng fú huà bāo hán jiāo wài chūn guāng biàn hé chǎng jǐng chéng nèi jiē shì sān ge bù fen
sentences.english: .. allowing the entire city to be fully captured in a single painting.

sentences.simplified: 人物多达500余位。
sentences.traditional: 人物多達500餘位。
sentences.pinyin: rén wù duō dá yú wèi
sentences.english: The entire painting consists of three sections: the spring scenery on the outskirts, scenes along the Bian River, and the city streets, ..

sentences.simplified: 如果用现代眼光来看，
sentences.traditional: 如果用現代眼光來看，
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ yòng xiàn dài yǎn guāng lái kàn
sentences.english: .. depicting more than 500 figures in total.

sentences.simplified: 你甚至能从画中找到“外卖小哥”、“便利店”，甚至像“宠物粮食铺”这样的场景。
sentences.traditional: 你甚至能從畫中找到“外賣小哥”、“便利店”，甚至像“寵物糧食鋪”這樣的場景。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ shèn zhì néng cóng huà zhōng zhǎo dào wài mài xiǎo gē biàn lì diàn shèn zhì xiàng chǒng wù liáng shi pù zhè yàng de chǎng jǐng
sentences.english: From a modern perspective, ..

sentences.simplified: 你能想到的那些现代大都市里的东西，这里基本都有，这让欣赏过程充满了乐趣。
sentences.traditional: 你能想到的那些現代大都市裡的東西，這裡基本都有，這讓欣賞過程充滿了樂趣。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ néng xiǎng dào de nà xiē xiàn dài dà dū shì lǐ de dōng xi zhè lǐ jī běn dōu yǒu zhè ràng xīn shǎng guò chéng chōng mǎn le lè qù
sentences.english: .. you can even find scenes in the painting that resemble a “delivery courier”, a “convenience store”, and even a “pet food shop”.
Almost everything you can think of in a modern metropolis can be found here, which makes the viewing experience all the more enjoyable.

sentences.simplified: 现在，《清明上河图》原版存放在北京故宫博物院，
sentences.traditional: 現在，《清明上河圖》原版存放在北京故宮博物院，
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài qīng míng shàng hé tú yuán bǎn cún fàng zài běi jīng gù gōng bó wù yuàn

sentences.simplified: 不定期展出。
sentences.traditional: 不定期展出。
sentences.pinyin: bú dìng qī zhǎn chū
sentences.english: Currently, the original version of “Along the River During the Qingming Festival” is stored in the Palace Museum in Beijing ..

sentences.simplified: 世界各地博物馆也有不少摹本展出，
sentences.traditional: 世界各地博物館也有不少摹本展出，
sentences.pinyin: shì jiè gè dì bó wù guǎn yě yǒu bù shǎo mó běn zhǎn chū
sentences.english: .. and is exhibited periodically.

sentences.simplified: 如果有机会，可以亲眼去看看这个千年前的世界级大都市的风采。
sentences.traditional: 如果有機會，可以親眼去看看這個千年前的世界級大都市的風采。

sentences.english: Museums around the world also have many replicas on display.

sentence_translations: Dreams of Bianjing: Along the River During the Qingming Festival
London, Paris, and New York—each international metropolis has its own unique charm.
China also has similar cities, ..
.. whether it is Beijing or Shanghai, their bustling atmosphere attracts countless visitors to come and experience it for themselves.
However, the “international metropolis” we are going to talk about might be a city you haven’t heard of before—Bianjing.
Bianjing was the capital of the Northern Song dynasty more than a thousand years ago.
At that time, it was also called Dongjing, and today it is known as Kaifeng.
Near Bianjing flowed the Bian River, and the geographic conditions were highly favorable for the development of an agricultural economy.
To ensure a stable food supply and convenient transportation, the Northern Song chose Bianjing as its capital.
The developed water transport system quickly made Bianjing an important logistics and commercial center of the Northern Song.
To prevent local armies from becoming too powerful, ..
.. the Northern Song loosened land restrictions on farmers, allowing the population to move freely.
Due to population loss, there was a sharp decline in agricultural tax revenue.
In order to compensate for the lost fiscal revenue, ..
.. the Northern Song dynasty encouraged the development of industry and commerce to collect more industrial and commercial taxes.
Under the guidance of that policy, people flocked to live and do business in Bianjing, ..
.. and the population of Bianjing reached over one million.
Bianjing not only became the economic and cultural center of the Northern Song dynasty, ..
.. but was also the most populous city in the world at that time.
People could buy goods from all over the country in Bianjing.
There were street performances, ..
.. as well as teahouses with music, snack stalls at alley entrances, and luxurious grand restaurants, everything you could imagine.
The night markets outside Xuande Gate and north of Zhuque Gate were brightly lit, exuding a distinctly modern urban atmosphere.
Unfortunately, we cannot travel through time to witness these bustling scenes with our own eyes.
Fortunately, a painter of that era used his remarkable brushwork to depict this marvelous painting for us.
This painter’s name was Zhang Zeduan.
The emperor at the time, Song Huizong, had a deep love for the arts.
He established an imperial painting academy and recruited many talented artists.
Zhang Zeduan, who came to Bianjing to study, was recruited to become a court painter.
In order to showcase the prosperity of Bianjing and to allow the emperor to see the real lives of the common people, ..
.. Zhang Zeduan used a realistic style to paint Bianjing during the Qingming Festival.
This is “Along the River During the Qingming Festival”.
Through this painting, we can catch a glimpse of the splendor of Bianjing, this international metropolis from a thousand years ago.
“Along the River During the Qingming Festival” is 24.8 centimeters wide and 528 centimeters long. It is a handscroll painting on silk.
The composition adopts the scattered perspective method of traditional Chinese painting, ..
.. allowing the entire city to be fully captured in a single painting.
The entire painting consists of three sections: the spring scenery on the outskirts, scenes along the Bian River, and the city streets, ..
.. depicting more than 500 figures in total.
From a modern perspective, ..
.. you can even find scenes in the painting that resemble a “delivery courier”, a “convenience store”, and even a “pet food shop”.
Almost everything you can think of in a modern metropolis can be found here, which makes the viewing experience all the more enjoyable.
Currently, the original version of “Along the River During the Qingming Festival” is stored in the Palace Museum in Beijing ..
.. and is exhibited periodically.
Museums around the world also have many replicas on display.
If you have the chance, you can go and see for yourself the splendor of this world-class metropolis from a thousand years ago.
